BiblicalUsage: Hereth is a thicket in Judah, named once, where David hid while Saul hunted him. The prophet Gad told David not to stay in the hold but to go into the land of Judah, and David came and remained in the forest of Hareth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God leads His people out of hiding and into the open, even when the open looks more dangerous than the thicket.
